changes.title: Recorder shutdown
changes.text: Statistics recording now finishes closing even when simultaneous flush requests overload a stalled writer.

changes.title: Compact change history
changes.text: Changes now groups icons under one heading per category, uses paired SPD columns and gold window styling, and names the exact APK in every change popup.

changes.title: Build attribution
changes.text: Verified changes from TEST51 onward now appear under their actual APK builds instead of being combined under TEST63; unavailable history stays clearly marked.

changes.title: Build navigation
changes.text: Choose builds through compact groups of twelve instead of stepping through every older APK.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I corrected the layout and build attribution in Changes, and fixed a statistics writer that could fail to finish closing under overload. Older history remains unavailable wherever the evidence has not yet been verified.
